LanguageData.Pony_Batpony.description:
Ponies are a race of magical quadrupeds from the planet Foenum. Their ancestry is incredibly complex, divided into numerous subspecies, each with their own unique traits. As a whole, ponykind practices harmony and cooperation; however, the harsh reality of the rim has led many to abandon those ideals in the pursuit of survival.

Though not bipedal, members of this race have adapted most clothing and prostheses to accommodate themselves. Their hooves possess an unusual degree of dexterity, allowing them to manipulate objects as easily as any creature with hands. Each individual also bears a cutiemark on their flank—a unique symbol signifying their profession, talent, or personality. While most ponies are herbivores and exhibit a strong aversion to meat, some subspecies have a more carnivorous diet.

<color=#AAAAAA>Bat ponies</color> are a nocturnal race blending the traits of both bats and ponies. They have a strong affinity for fruit, dwell primarily in mountains and caves, and utilize invisibility magic to elude thestrals, their oldest enemy. Being a subspecies of ponykind, bat ponies can be found all over the world as part of different nations.
